about: Freeze 4 of demo/percus-yevick: the pile built again with the notation add-on (pull request #273) reading each paper's math, each equation with the words its paper gives for its symbols; nothing else changed. Freezes 1 to 3 are unchanged and their verdicts stand. Committed alone, before any question was asked of the notation pile. Held by test_percus_yevick.py.
known_when_frozen: freezes 1 and 2's results and the ceiling (9 of 11 steps held somewhere); notation's glossaries on these papers; 1,303 of 1,394 equations given a symbols line; nothing any ranker served from the notation pile
how_run: pipeline.py --math notation, then union.py --math notation on the same WORK; verdicts named percus-yevick:notation:R1 and on
pass_rules: R1 to R5 (pipeline.py) and R7 to R10 (union.py), the bars as frozen in FROZEN.json and FROZEN-2.json
the_guess: the kernel's author questions (R1's count) find at least 3 of 11 steps on the notation pile, with R3 and R4 satisfied: the guess holds; 1 or 0: it is wrong; 2: too close to call
